P&G to Cut Up to 30% of Product-Supply Workers Amid Automation Push

The consumer goods company says the job cuts are part of its ongoing effort to lower supply-chain costs

By

Procter & Gamble said it plans to cut 20% to 30% of its product-supply jobs by 2030, as it implements more automation into its supply chain.

The consumer goods company said the job cuts, which will include contractors, are part of its ongoing effort to lower supply-chain costs.
